annotation.summary: A cheerful follow-up question becomes worried when an apparently positive statement receives no reassurance.
annotation.visual: Four panels alternate between Anakin speaking and Padme reacting. Her initial smile becomes a concerned expression in the final panel.
annotation.mechanism: A missing answer exposes the ominous implication of an initially reassuring plan. Repeating the question turns optimism into doubt.
scenarios: Hear that efficiency is improving and ask whether working hours will shrink
Learn that data collection is increasing and ask whether consent is required
Be promised a simpler process without being told who does the extra work

texts: So we can go home early?
We can go home early, right?
examples.why: The silence makes the hoped-for benefit doubtful.

avoid: Preserve the shift from optimism to worry; do not put the full answer in the silent panel.
